title: Optimize AMD Settings
name: optimize-amd-settings
modal: This tweak optimizes AMD Radeon registry settings: disables ULPS to prevent clock drops and micro-stutters, enables AMD Shader Cache, configures Flip Queue Size for lower input lag, and increases TDR Delay.
deepDescription:
Applies the following optimizations for AMD Radeon GPUs:

- Disable ULPS (Ultra Low Power State) → Prevents GPU sleep lag and micro-stutters
- Disable ULPS NA → Disables deep sleep on non-active adapters
- Force Shader Cache (KMD_EnableShaderCache = 1) → Eliminates in-game shader compilation lag
- Flip Queue Size → 1 (Reduces input lag and frame queuing delay)
- TDR Delay → 8s (Prevents premature driver timeout crashes during heavy load)
description: Optimizes AMD Radeon registry and driver settings to improve gaming performance and reduce stutters
